symptom: `set (ShowContentAs: attribute) on dg column(Name)` on a column created as dynamicText: the project as stored fails with CE0463 at the Data grid 2 (0 errors before the SET, and for a column created as attribute)
cause: ResetHiddenColumnProperties reset hidden PRIMITIVE column properties only (#1519); the column's dynamicText TextTemplate, hidden unless showContentAs is "dynamicText", stayed filled where CREATE stores null
file: `mdl/backend/pagemutator/column_hidden_reset.go` (column path now passes the template constructor), `mutator.go` (`SetColumnProperty` creates a null template before writing its text)
insight: Same defect as the Accordion group's headerText, found by measuring rather than by analogy: the column-vs-control diff (TypePointer -> PropertyKey in the JSON dump) showed only dynamicText differing ('Item {1}', one param vs null). Only `docker check --no-update-widgets` shows it. The reverse switch is refused unless the text is given, because the schema DefaultValue is "". Side quirk left as is: in a column SET `Content:` resolves to the custom-content SLOT (schema key `content`, case-insensitive) before the `dynamicText` alias CREATE uses, so describe prints `Content: 'Item'` that a SET cannot write back — use `dynamicText:`; and `ContentParams` does not parse in a SET at all
